changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Pin optional data-mart scope and implementation variant while keeping policy details in immutable ModelSpec snapshots.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_variant_code CHECK (variant_code IS NULL OR variant_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$'); ALTER TABLE modeling_model_spec_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_spec_revision_variant_code CHECK (variant_code IS NULL OR variant_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$'); CREATE INDEX idx_model_spec_data_mart ON modeling_model_spec (tenant_id, data_mart_id, model_type, status) WHERE data_mart_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_model_spec_revision_data_mart ON modeling_model_spec_revision (tenant_id, data_mart_id, revision DESC) WHERE data_mart_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_model_spec_active_dimension_variant ON modeling_model_spec ( tenant_id, plan_id, dimension_definition_id, coalesce(data_mart_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), coalesce(variant_code, 'DEFAULT') ) WHERE contract_version = 2 AND model_type = 'DIMENSION' AND dimension_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'ARCHIVED';
